Romantic dinner
May 2026 • Couples
Absolutely amazing dining experience. My wife and I were there for a vacation and were attracted by the restaurant's good reviews and menu. 

The atmosphere and environment were very comforting and the staff was friendly and welcoming.

We had planned to order one appetizer, two pastas and a main dish (veal) for sharing. Luckily, a kind waitress advised us the portions would be excessive for just the two of us, so we reduced our choice to 3 plates instead.

To our surprise, apart from the bread, there was an additional croquet as a snack, which was crispy and presentable. The appetizer, grilled octopus, was delicious with artistic plating. The seafood pasta was generous in terms of portion and there was an abundant variety of seafood like clams, prawns, squid and small octopus. The veal with risotto was one of the best dishes we had had recently - the meat was well seasoned, tender and satisfying.
We were too full to enjoy any dessert, but the team nicely delivered a small, refreshing lemon sorbet as a treat.

One female staff at the restaurant was really sweet and offered to take wonderful photos for us, and she did it at various angles like a professional photographer! We were very grateful for her hospitality.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An unforgettable dining experience at Il Muro – Salinda Resort
Nov 2025 • Friends
Il Muro at Salinda Resort truly exceeded every expectation. From the moment we arrived, the service was warm, attentive, and genuinely hospitable. The hostess greeted us with the kind of welcome that immediately makes you feel like a cherished guest rather than just another table. She even offered to take photos of us, which was such a thoughtful touch and set the tone for the rest of the evening.

We ordered the pizza quattro formaggi, the bronzino, the scallops, followed by tiramisu, and a selection of cocktails – and every single dish was outstanding. The pizza was perfectly crisp with a rich blend of cheeses, the bronzino was cooked to perfection with delicate seasoning, and the scallops were tender, fresh, and beautifully plated. The tiramisu was the perfect ending: light, creamy, and deliciously authentic.

The cocktails were refined, balanced, and visually stunning – clearly crafted with care. What also stood out was the atmosphere: elegant yet relaxed, with an intimate ambiance that made the whole experience feel special. For a fine dining restaurant inside a luxury resort, the final bill was surprisingly reasonable, especially for non-Vietnamese guests used to European or American pricing.

Il Muro is the kind of place you don’t just eat at – you remember. I highly, highly recommend it to anyone staying in Phu Quoc or even visiting from elsewhere. A perfect blend of exceptional food, impeccable service, and refined ambiance. Bravo to the entire team!
